items.title: Chuck Israels interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 11, 2021

ctx.x: I believe I did. I don’t think I’ve looked at it for a long time. I think at some point I was concerned that people were paying attention to me and now I know they’re not.

Well I am. So it’s interesting because I’ll just read a little bit of it. This is probably an update from his 1955 Leonard Feather original edition. And it says: “Chuck Israels, bass, born in New York City 1936, attended junior high in Cleveland, then to New York City where he went to the High School of Performing Arts, attended MIT, president of the Symphony Orchestra, self-taught on bass from 1955, studied music at Brandeis.” It mentions Herb Pomeroy and of course it mentions your gig with Billie Holiday and…
